timeline.summary: Century Enka credited 37.96 lakh shares of ABREL Century Energy to its demat account on 25th April 2026 to maintain its 26% captive power stake.
Century Enka received three GST enforcement notices for penalties aggregating to ₹17 lakh on April 28, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹483.53 Cr (+8.9% YoY), net profit ₹39.4 Cr (+482.8% YoY).
Century Enka released its Q4-FY26/FY26 investor presentation detailing financial performance and operational highlights.

Century Enka Limited’s **Rahul Dubey (VP Legal & Company Secretary)** uploaded the audio recording of its Q4-FY26/FY26 earnings conference call on 22 May 2026 at 2:00 PM (IST) via [www.centuryenka.com](https://www.centuryenka.com).
Century Enka held its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 22, 2026, guiding to an improved operating margin of 7-10% and announcing a ₹100 Cr capex plan for FY27.
Century Enka reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹558.23 Cr and net profit of ₹18.49 Cr on October 27, 2026.
